Specification: This module defines a TLC-specific state constraint for model checking an instanced inner FIFO specification without modifying the underlying specification module. The comments explain that the underlying FIFO spec has an unbounded state space because the queue q can grow arbitrarily large, so this wrapper module introduces a constant bound qLen and a predicate qConstraint that restricts the queue length to be at most qLen. The file does not define the FIFO algorithm itself, any actions, or temporal properties; it only adds a finite-state constraint intended to be referenced from a TLC configuration.
